name: When the summons outlasted its caller · The Howling Vale and Shrine of Mel’Thandris
interpretationNote: Original interpretive environment art for The Howling Vale and Shrine of Mel’Thandris. Target reference: original pre-Cataclysm World of Warcraft Classic The Howling Vale and Shrine of Mel’Thandris. Preserve recognizable traits: Classic Ashenvale at Felwood’s edge: mossed ancient stone, a ruined moon-elf shrine within a hollow hill, twisting roots, deep blue-green forest shade and distant Felwood gloom. Not a screenshot, exact in-game map, surveyed route, mine floorplan or proof of character co-presence. Side-by-side comparison against the matching Classic area remains a human review gate.
